slides.texte_overlay: 𓆩 𓆪 5 ways to participate more in class 𓆩 𓆪

1) answer the first easy question
once you've spoken once, the second time is way less scary.

2) build on what someone else said
"to add to what she said…" counts as participating too.

3) prepare one question the night before
quiz yourself on your notes, and whatever you miss becomes your question.

4) give a real-life example
teachers love it, and it proves you actually understood.

5) keep your phone in your bag
you can't jump into a discussion you only half heard.
